new file mode 100644
index 0000000..789ebee
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/config/tracing_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingConfigValidate(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name        string
+		ratio       float64
+		propagators []TracingPropagator
+		wantErr     string
+	}{
+		{name: "zero", ratio: 0},
+		{name: "one", ratio: 1},
+		{name: "fraction", ratio: 0.5},
+		{name: "negative", ratio: -0.1, wantErr: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{name: "above one", ratio: 1.1, wantErr: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{name: "NaN", ratio: math.NaN(), wantErr: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{
+			name: "all propagators", ratio: 1,
+			propagators: []TracingPropagator{
+				TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage, TracingPropagatorB3,
+				TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger, TracingPropagatorXRay,
+				TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone,
+			},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "unknown propagator", ratio: 1,
+			propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorBaggage, "unknown"},
+			wantErr:     "invalid propagator option: unknown",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			err := (&TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: tt.ratio, Propagators: tt.propagators}).validate()
+			if tt.wantErr != "" {
+				require.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+			} else {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestLoadTracingOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name        string
+		contents    string
+		wantRatio   float64
+		propagators []TracingPropagator
+		wantErr     string
+	}{
+		{
+			name: "defaults", contents: "tracing:\n  enabled: true\n", wantRatio: 1,
+			propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "snake case", contents: "tracing:\n  sampling_ratio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, baggage]\n",
+			wantRatio: 0.5, propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorBaggage},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "camel case", contents: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n",
+			wantRatio: 0.5, propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "invalid ratio", contents: "tracing:\n  sampling_ratio: 1.1\n",
+			wantErr: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1",
+		},
+		{
+			name: "invalid propagator", contents: "tracing:\n  propagators: [baggage, invalid]\n",
+			wantErr: "invalid propagator option: invalid",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tt.contents), 0600))
+			result, err := Load(path)
+			if tt.wantErr != "" {
+				require.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantRatio, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.propagators, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+			assert.Equal(t, TracingJaeger, result.Config.Tracing.Exporter)
+			assert.Equal(t, "localhost", result.Config.Tracing.Jaeger.Host)
+		})
+	}
+}
